title: Pointer
description: A file of the ask's root, and optionally a place in it: a root-relative path, then `#` and an anchor, `L<start>-L<end>` for a line range or else a heading or an ID (Consistency Conventions, "Excerpts and media"). Its length is the contract's pointer limit. The grammar is the contract's `readPointer`, not this schema: a pointer it reads as invalid is no request error but an `unresolved-pointer` warning (AD-12, FR-8).
